messages:
deploybot: staged rollout started for models/summarizer@v2.4. preflight checks passed but eval-gate reported a regression on 1 prompt set. holding for manual decision. /deploy pin/rollback options available. @alice @dave please advise.

alice: received. thanks deploybot. can you paste the eval delta and which route is impacted? is it customer-facing summarizer or internal QA only?

dave: quick summary (copied from eval-run-29555):
```
email_summarize: delta_ROUGE-L = -4.6% (95% CI), hallucination_rate +0.2pp, readability_score +0.3
meeting_notes: delta_ROUGE-L = -0.1%
kb_summary: delta_ROUGE-L = +0.2%
```
impacted route: /v1/summarize.email (traffic ~8% of canary). sample diffs show more conservative summaries that drop some actionable lines.

ben: from infra perspective we have capacity to extend canary for another 2h. we can also pin /v1/summarize.email to summarizer@v2.3 for EU region only if product wants.

claire: ops note: pinning route is low risk (config change only). rollback of whole artifact would be heavier (restarts). recommend pin-first approach to limit blast radius.

emma: product POV: if email summarizer drops key action items that's bad. is the -4.6% ROUGE correlated with lost actions? any qualitative examples?

dave: example snippet: 
- v2.3: "Action items: follow up with finance by Friday; include invoice id 1234."
- v2.4: "Follow up with finance."
so yes, sometimes details are pruned. not all samples, maybe ~15% of email_summarize failures.

alice: thanks. proposal: 1) pin /v1/summarize.email -> models/summarizer@v2.3 immediately for EU and NA canaries, 2) extend canary for remaining routes + run targeted eval set with more emails, 3) update release notes and postmortem if we promote later. any objections?

dave: +1 on pin + extended eval. i'll run a focused 1k-sample sweep and post results in ~45m.

ben: I'll schedule the canary extension and make sure autoscaling holds.

claire: I'll apply the route pin now.

claire: deploybot: execute route-pin /v1/summarize.email -> summarizer@v2.3 scope=canary-regions=[EU,NA]

deploybot: acknowledged. starting route-pin...

deploybot: route-pin complete for /v1/summarize.email -> summarizer@v2.3 (EU, NA). change recorded in release ledger: change_id=chg_29555_pin_01.

alice: thanks all. emma can you update release notes with: "Partial pin applied: email summarizer pinned to v2.3 in canary regions due to eval-gate regression. Remaining routes continue on v2.4 under extended canary. Monitoring in place."

emma: noted, will update and add a short blurb in the change window doc.

dave: posting follow-up eval results in ~40m. if delta persists we'll either rollback the artifact or cut a patch quickfix. for now pin + extend seems safest.

alice: agreed. closing hold. we'll reconvene if dave's sweep flags >10% failure or any customer reports come in. :thumbsup:
